feature: EXT-F-2013-T10 public guest Chat first reply, same-conversation follow-up, and new conversation after reload
scope: fresh owned guest profile; unpredictable article fixture in the owned browser tab; real Chat opening, same-conversation follow-up, and post-reload new conversation
classification: Resource-valid child failure at the first real guest answer: the canonical opening request returned HTTP 200 and the server emitted semantic completion success, but the only rendered assistant article contained a tool card and no terminal assistant prose. The get_page_text result POST was accepted with continuation_needed=true; no correlated /resume request was observed before the driver failed. Evidence establishes an end-to-end answer failure on this candidate but does not assign its cause to the product, client continuation path, or observer.
limits: The report records one unhandled-rejection count without its reason or stack; the probe deliberately does not read rejection properties because they may contain private data.
The run stopped before same-conversation follow-up and post-reload new conversation, so neither was tested.
The artifact was loaded through the hosted key-adapted unpacked path; this is not an actual Chrome Web Store installed-copy lifecycle.
Prior published 0.2.205 acceptance used an older server revision and is not a same-condition control; this run does not establish a 0.2.530 regression.
continuation_path_for_diagnosis: src/lib/tools/device-handoff.ts: handOffDeviceCalls forwards a delivery continuation signal to continueRun after an accepted tool result.
src/lib/tools/dispatch.ts: accepted continuation_needed is broadcast as STREAM_CONTINUE.
src/hooks/use-chat-stream.ts: STREAM_CONTINUE invokes resumeRunRef; queued signals drain after the suspended stream finalizes.
